info.name: plucia blackbox orchestrator
info.description:
Two full journeys through POST /v1/turns (real-estate tenant with a LoRA adapter, insurance tenant without), plus dedupe, wrong-scope 403, the copilot drafts loop, and observability reads.

Prereqs: docker compose up -d, python seeds/seed_qdrant.py, Ollama running, uvicorn app.main:app.
